canonicalNames: Exact upstream component exports, case-sensitive; upstream spelling is preserved.
categoriesOrigin: Inform UI browsing categories inferred from official names, not upstream metadata.
aliasesOrigin: Inform UI semantic aliases for specific interface uses. These are not upstream OpenAI export names.

aliases.name: InfoCircle
aliases.purpose: Supplementary information or an information tooltip

aliases.name: CheckCircle
aliases.purpose: Successful result with a circular status glyph

aliases.name: XCircle
aliases.purpose: Failed result with a circular status glyph

aliases.name: Minus
aliases.purpose: Subtract an amount or collapse a simple item

aliases.name: ArrowLeft
aliases.purpose: Physical left-pointing arrow; caller chooses RTL behavior

aliases.name: ArrowRight
aliases.purpose: Physical right-pointing arrow; caller chooses RTL behavior

aliases.name: ChevronLeft
aliases.purpose: Physical left-pointing disclosure or navigation glyph

aliases.name: ChevronRight
aliases.purpose: Physical right-pointing disclosure or navigation glyph

aliases.name: DotsHorizontal
aliases.purpose: Additional actions in a horizontal toolbar

aliases.name: DotsVertical
aliases.purpose: Additional actions in a vertical list

aliases.name: Trash
aliases.purpose: Move the current item to trash

aliases.name: Archive
aliases.purpose: Archive an item without deleting it

aliases.name: PaperclipAttach
aliases.purpose: Attach a file to a message

aliases.name: ImageSquare
aliases.purpose: An image attachment or image action

aliases.name: StarFilled

aliases.name: Code
